content.short: CCXT is an open-source trading library giving one unified API across 100+ exchanges, including Hyperliquid.
content.description: CCXT is the long-standing open-source library for programmatic trading, normalising the APIs of more than a hundred exchanges behind a single interface across JavaScript, Python, PHP and C#. Its Hyperliquid integration means a strategy written against CCXT can treat Hyperliquid like any other venue, and Hyperliquid's own builder documentation points to it under APIs. For anyone running the same logic across centralised and on-chain venues, that normalisation is most of the value.
